text: {"lessons":["My account value has risen overall, but ten monthly observations are too little to tell whether my trades helped; I should assess progress over a longer period against my apartment goal.","I sold Stock A below my average cost and later bought more, while selling Stock B and D at losses. I should base trades on current prospects and risk limits, not on my purchase price or a desire to recover losses.","I realized gains on Stock E by selling portions as it rose, but I cannot know whether those sales improved my outcome without comparing alternatives. I should avoid assuming that taking profits or trading often guarantees better growth, and keep enough cash for my plan."]}
